answeredQuestions: Q1 Leak coverage: which tracked or generated surfaces that can carry or route sk-code-webflow / sk-code-obsidian (or a local-* private skill) does packet 013 miss? Check the committed trigger index, Hermes sync and .hermes/skills, runtime mirrors, compiled routing and activation manifests, skill-graph.json from --export-json, the advisor DB and scorer vocabulary, OpenCode plugins (system-skill-advisor.js surface detection), doctor checks, description / graph-metadata / changelog / README generators, CI artifacts, and the pre-commit and pre-push hooks.
Q3 Executability by a DeepSeek writer: does every task name exact files, make one change, carry a proving command, map to acceptance criteria and a rollback? Which tasks are vague?
